bio_am: Գանձակեցի հին հայդուկ, ինկած է Ապարանի կռիւներուն մէջ՝ 1918 Մայիս 28-ին։
bio_en: Artem Nanumian, known as Zemliak, was a haiduk from Ganja who rose from the working peasantry and joined the revolutionary movement young, taking part in the actions of 1896. On his return from one mission he was imprisoned in Batum. He served for years with the fedayi bands, including alongside Dali Ghazar and Keri, and his activity continued until the start of the World War. He fell heroically on 28 May 1918 in the unequal fighting at Abaran, as the Turkish forces were driven back.
